feedback:
Approved to race as a single-variable test of the sensor footprint. The candidate keeps the iteration 5 geometry (sensors at x = -0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05 and y = 0.07) and the iteration 5 controller (kp 1.5, ki 0.5, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.2, last_direction). Only sensor_size changes, from 0.012 to 0.016. Iteration 5 is the best raced design (417.25). Its oval finished 20 of 20 at progress 0.998, but its s-bend ended off track at progress 0.56 with 0.6 line-loss events per run, and its slalom stayed at progress 0.19 with exactly 1 line-loss event per run. Iteration 4 showed that widening the x spread to ±0.07 hurt (oval finish 0.6), so the x spread stays at ±0.05. Iteration 3 showed kd 0.4 was the lever that fixed the oval, so kd and ki stay as they are. The remaining untested lever on the tight tracks is the footprint, which is why this candidate is worth racing now.

Read the result in this order. (1) If s-bend and slalom line_loss_events fall and slalom progress rises above 0.2, keep sensor_size 0.016 and consider a further gain or speed step. (2) If the oval finish rate drops below 0.8 or oval steering_oscillation rises well above 0.25, the larger footprint is averaging in too much background on straights, so return sensor_size to 0.012 and change kd to 0.3 instead. (3) If the slalom line_loss_events stay at 1 per run, the loss is at a fixed start or first-bend point rather than a geometry limit, so the next test should change controller.line_loss to search_left or search_right, not geometry.
requested_changes: If the oval finish rate stays at or above 0.8 and s-bend or slalom line_loss_events fall below their iteration 5 values (0.6 and 1.0), keep geometry.sensor_size at 0.016 and try controller.base_speed 1.4 with the other fields unchanged, since speed has not been tested on the tighter tracks at this geometry.

If the oval finish rate drops below 0.8 or oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.25 with sensor_size 0.016, return geometry.sensor_size to 0.012 and set controller.kd to 0.3, using the iteration 5 geometry, since iteration 3 showed kd 0.4 gave the oval its finish-rate gain.

If slalom line_loss_events stay at 1 per run with sensor_size 0.016, keep the footprint and change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_left or search_right, matching the side the robot drifts toward on the first bend, since sensor coverage alone has not stopped the slalom loss in iterations 3 to 5.
